bills.summary: Amends the Environmental Crimes Law (Lei 9.605/1998).
Makes killing prosecutors or judges because of their office an aggravated homicide.
Sets periods for public-sector job exams and university entrance exams.
Creates Brazil's regulated greenhouse-gas emissions trading system (SBCE).
Sets how states are compensated for ICMS revenue losses.
Regulates postal services provided to federal government bodies.
Raises penalties for assault, threats and contempt against health professionals.
Amends the organic law of the Advocacia-Geral da União.
Makes the Tribunais de Contas permanent, essential bodies of external oversight.
Sets rules for clinical research with human participants.
Approves Bolivia's accession protocol to Mercosur.
Regulates video-on-demand streaming, with Brazilian-content and funding obligations.
Writes minimum funding for the SUAS social-assistance system into the Constitution.
Suspends accreditation of schools that refuse to enrol students.
Lets the Army carry out engineering works without a public tender in set cases.
Lets states and municipalities assign rights to tax receivables and protest tax debts out of court.
Sets national guidelines for a social water and sewage tariff.
Adjusts the environmental inspection fee (TCFA).
Changes rules for insurance companies under Decree-Law 73/1966.
Regulates offshore wind power generation.
Requires restrictive-rights penalties for people convicted of pedophilia crimes.
Includes the care economy in the national accounts.
Changes the security measures applied to people found not criminally responsible.
Tax reform: replaces several consumption taxes with a VAT-style system.
Creates a national protection programme for people with fibromyalgia.
Bars spending freezes on the National Intellectual Property Institute's funds.
Extends to 2031 the duty to show Brazilian films in cinemas.
Lets a teacher hold a second paid public position.
Creates a national plain-language policy for public bodies.
Creates a National Day of Human Rights Defenders.
Cuts the maximum working week to 36 hours over ten years.
Creates the Apprentice Statute.
Sets resolution regimes for financial institutions supervised by the central bank, SUSEP and CVM.
Expands tax credits for R&D investment in certain IT goods.
Authorizes donating two helicopters to Paraguay.
